name: niu-lai-3d
description: A story-driven 3D platformer with 25 acts across five worlds.

scripts.format: prettier --write models.js story.js stages.js expedition.js highlands.js campaign.js platformer.js autoplay.js journey-renderer.js journey.js tests/*.mjs index.html journey.css README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check models.js story.js stages.js expedition.js highlands.js campaign.js platformer.js autoplay.js journey-renderer.js journey.js tests/*.mjs index.html journey.css README.md
scripts.lint: eslint models.js story.js stages.js expedition.js highlands.js campaign.js platformer.js autoplay.js journey-renderer.js journey.js tests/*.mjs
